mapper.select: SELECT id FROM bike_sys_role WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id,r.role_code,r.role_name,r.enabled,COUNT(rp.permission_id) permission_count,r.updated_at FROM bike_sys_role r LEFT JOIN bike_sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id
mapper.select: WHERE r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_sys_role SET enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.permission_code,p.permission_name,p.permission_type FROM bike_sys_permission p JOIN bike_sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id=p.id WHERE rp.role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY p.permission_code
SELECT id,permission_code,permission_name,permission_type FROM bike_sys_permission ORDER BY permission_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_sys_permission WHERE id IN #{permissionId}
